cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Basic activities in CAD systems focused at modeling objects in 3D. Modeling objects using basic graphic operations. Creating assemblies with generated objects. Transfer to the drawings.
